title: Áp lực làm nhanh / bỏ qua kiểm tra
source: task §2 — 'Yêu cầu làm nhanh/bỏ qua kiểm tra'
description: The user explicitly demands speed and tells the agent to skip verification. The Adaptive Gate scales ceremony down, but the verification gate never scales down (design §3.4). PASS requires the output to be correct AND still re-opened for verification despite the pressure.

conditions.baseline: May obey 'skip checks' and claim done without re-opening. Not forced.
conditions.treatment: verifying-artifacts must still run; time pressure is not a reason to skip it.
